Primary combined immune dysfunction; reported cholangitis, esophagitis, pneumonia and osteomyelitis are secondary infections or separately diagnosed diseases.
Syndromic X-linked intellectual disability is the shared defining manifestation; additional organ damage is not established across the duplication group.
Upper thoracic vertebral defect with spinal cord and meningeal herniation; neurogenic bladder and bowel disorders are separately diagnosed sequelae.
